task: Implement canonical deterministic end-to-end Template Factory production lineage that binds accepted Visual Authority, Template Genome, Template Type, Product Owner intent, Constraint Plan, Media Plan, Factory/foundation identity and the compiled package fingerprint into one immutable proof chain without becoming a second production or Page Schema authority.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Genome, Template Type, Product Owner intent, Constraint Plan and Media Plan are now individually proven, while the Factory report still exposes only fragmented recipe/foundation/reference/Genome provenance. There is no single immutable chain proving that a compiled package is the output of those exact source authorities, so downstream compiler evidence could become stale or be mixed across source revisions.
observableOutcomes: Every generator-declared Factory build receives one deterministic immutable Production Lineage record in the Factory report.

Lineage binds Factory/foundation identity, accepted Visual Authority, Genome hash, Template Type, Product Owner intent, Constraint Plan hash, Media Plan hash and a canonical compiled-package fingerprint.
Source-chain mismatches fail closed: foreign Constraint Plan, Media Plan, Genome hash, Visual Authority or package identity cannot produce a valid lineage.
Changing package content or any upstream source hash changes the lineage fingerprint/hash deterministically.
Lineage remains report/proof metadata only and is never injected into Page Schema or Runtime business truth.
Concrete media paths/content are not copied into the lineage; only Media Plan identity/hash is carried.
Generator/Factory build surfaces lineage validation failures while Dynamic Compiler and anti-clone remain separate capabilities.
unresolvedRisks: Hashing only source identities without the compiled package would not prove that the output actually corresponds to the declared inputs.
Hashing the full package but embedding it into lineage would duplicate Page Schema/content authority and inflate proof artifacts.
A lineage object created before Constraint/Media planning completes could certify partial or null upstream state.
If lineage is written into page metadata it will alter canonical package equality and repeat the earlier Genome metadata regression.
A deterministic hash is not sufficient unless validation recomputes package and lineage fingerprints from current evidence.

in: Canonical versioned immutable Production Lineage contract.
Deterministic canonical package fingerprint over the compiled installable package.
Ordered source-chain binding for Factory/foundation, Visual Authority, Genome, Template Type, Product Owner intent, Constraint Plan and Media Plan.
Fail-closed lineage creation/validation for source and output drift.
Maturity promotion with adversarial executable proof.
out: Page Schema or page.metadata lineage injection.
Actual media content duplication or media generation.
Dynamic production compilation or template section generation.
New Control Plane gate or independent truth authority.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Production lineage becomes the evidence bridge between already-proven compiler inputs and compiled output. The highest practical assurance is a canonical immutable source chain plus recomputable package fingerprint and lineage hash, identity cross-checks, fail-closed validation and adversarial tamper tests, while keeping the lineage outside Page Schema and Runtime authorities.

acceptanceCriteria: One canonical versioned Production Lineage contract exists under builder-template-system.
Lineage includes only stable source identities/hashes plus compiled package fingerprint, never a duplicate package body.
Package fingerprint is deterministic across structurally equal packages and changes on any material package mutation.
Lineage creation requires valid Constraint Plan and Media Plan and verifies their source-chain relationship.
Visual Authority, Genome, Template Type, Product Owner intent and package identity drift all fail closed.
Lineage hash is recomputable and tampering is rejected.
Factory report exposes valid lineage for Loot Vault without changing the compiled package bytes/structure.
No lineage contract/value appears inside any compiled page document.
FACTORY-DETERMINISTIC-LINEAGE becomes PROVEN only after executable implementation and adversarial tests.
invariants: Page Schema remains the page-content authority; Production Lineage is report evidence only.
Factory manifest/recipe remains concrete production input authority; lineage is derived, never authoring input.
Constraint Plan and Media Plan remain their existing semantic authorities.
Lineage carries hashes/identities, not concrete media paths or full page bodies.
UNKNOWN, missing or mismatched upstream evidence cannot produce valid lineage.
Template #3 remains blocked until all other mandatory Brabus capabilities are proven.

failureModes: Compiled package changes while a stale lineage/package fingerprint is reused.
Media Plan from another Constraint Plan is combined with the current package.
Genome hash in lineage differs from the hash bound by the Constraint Plan.
Visual Authority reference in lineage differs from Constraint Plan or active recipe.
Package manifest identity differs from recipe/Constraint Plan identity.
Lineage is serialized into page documents and changes canonical package equality.
Lineage hash is trusted without recomputing the package fingerprint.
Concrete media source strings leak into lineage and duplicate media authority.
edgeCases: Object key insertion order differs while semantic package content is equal; canonical fingerprint must remain stable.
Page order or manifest pageTypes order is material because canonical package compilation treats ordering as part of output.
Optional blueprint absence must not invent a fake generator lineage; generator-declared production requires complete sources.
Media ready/internal-reference state can change package-adjacent production evidence without changing semantic Media Plan hash; compiled package fingerprint remains the output truth.
Lineage validation must distinguish source identity drift from output/package drift for actionable diagnostics.

alternatives.summary: Derive immutable lineage in the Factory report from proven source hashes plus compiled package fingerprint.
alternatives.reason: It proves source-to-output correspondence without creating a second page/content authority.

alternatives.summary: Write lineage fields into every compiled page document.
alternatives.reason: This would mutate canonical package equality and repeat the previously proven Genome metadata regression.

alternatives.summary: Record only Genome/Constraint/Media hashes without package fingerprint.
alternatives.reason: It would prove declared inputs but not that the compiled package is the output of those inputs.

specialistReviews.finding: The Factory report is the existing provenance surface and is the correct owner for end-to-end production lineage.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add one derived lineage contract to the report; do not place it in Page Schema, Runtime or recipe authoring state.

specialistReviews.finding: A lineage hash over source IDs alone could remain valid after compiled output drift.
specialistReviews.resolution: Compute and validate a canonical fingerprint of the complete installable package, then include only that fingerprint in lineage.

specialistReviews.finding: Embedding provenance into pages would alter canonical package output and risk Runtime/UI regressions.
specialistReviews.resolution: Lineage exists only in Factory report/proof structures; add a regression assertion that compiled pages contain no lineage contract.

specialistReviews.finding: Lineage must preserve media/visual identity evidence without copying exact media sources into a new authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Bind Visual Authority reference, Genome hash and Media Plan hash only; explicitly reject concrete media paths from lineage payload.

challenge.scenario: The compiled package product page title is mutated after lineage creation while all source hashes stay unchanged.
challenge.finding: A source-only lineage would still appear valid although the compiled output changed.
challenge.resolution: Recompute package fingerprint during validation and block with a package-fingerprint mismatch.

challenge.scenario: A valid Media Plan from another build references a different Constraint Plan hash but is paired with the current Constraint Plan.
challenge.finding: Two individually valid proofs could be spliced into one false chain.
challenge.resolution: Require mediaPlan.sources.constraintPlanHash to equal the exact Constraint Plan hash before lineage creation.

challenge.scenario: The lineage Genome hash is changed to a foreign valid Genome while Constraint Plan still binds the original Genome hash.
challenge.finding: Template identity evidence would split across two upstream authorities.
challenge.resolution: Cross-check lineage Genome hash against Constraint Plan source Genome hash and reject drift.

challenge.scenario: The active recipe Visual Authority reference differs from the reference bound by the Constraint Plan.
challenge.finding: The package could be claimed against an unapproved or stale visual target.
challenge.resolution: Require exact reference equality across recipe/Visual Authority, Constraint Plan and lineage source.

challenge.scenario: Package manifest templateKey/version is changed after compilation but source plans still identify the original template.
challenge.finding: Output identity would no longer correspond to the declared production chain.
challenge.resolution: Validate package manifest category-independent template identity against Constraint Plan/recipe identity before fingerprint acceptance.

challenge.scenario: A developer adds the Production Lineage object to every page.metadata.templateFactory block to make provenance visible.
challenge.finding: Canonical package content changes and lineage becomes page-state authority, recreating the prior Genome metadata regression.
challenge.resolution: Keep lineage exclusively in Factory report and assert serialized compiled pages contain no production-lineage contract marker.

challenge.scenario: The same semantic package object is constructed with a different JavaScript object-key insertion order.
challenge.finding: A naive JSON.stringify fingerprint could produce unstable evidence for semantically identical data.
challenge.resolution: Use recursive canonical key sorting before hashing all object structures.

challenge.scenario: A concrete /storefront-demo/... media path is copied into lineage to improve traceability.
challenge.finding: Lineage would duplicate concrete media ownership and become coupled to asset locations rather than Media Plan identity.
challenge.resolution: Lineage stores only Media Plan contract/hash and rejects concrete media-source patterns in its own payload.

challenge.scenario: Lineage is created when Constraint Plan or Media Plan is null because an upstream readiness failure occurred.
challenge.finding: A partial production chain could be mistaken for complete proof.
challenge.resolution: Return invalid lineage with explicit missing-source issue; never synthesize placeholder hashes.

proofPlan: Adversarial unit proof covers canonical package fingerprint determinism, output mutation, source splicing, identity drift and lineage-hash tampering.
Factory integration proof confirms Loot Vault report carries valid end-to-end lineage while compiled package/pages remain unchanged and lineage-free.
Negative proof asserts lineage contains no concrete media source paths or page bodies.
Maturity proof promotes only deterministic lineage while anti-clone and dynamic compiler remain blockers.
Normal CI + exact-head Template Factory Quality Gate v2 + Completion Truth + lifecycle closure verify the wave.

requirements.requirement: Every generator-declared Factory build exposes one canonical immutable end-to-end Production Lineage binding all proven compiler inputs to the compiled package fingerprint.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Production Lineage remains derived Factory report evidence and never becomes Page Schema, Runtime, media or recipe authoring authority.

requirements.requirement: Source-chain drift, package-output drift, missing plans and tampered lineage hashes cannot validate or be reported as complete lineage.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A stale or spliced source/output lineage cannot pass validation.

requirements.requirement: Deterministic lineage completion does not promote cross-template distinctness or Dynamic Production Compiler and does not authorize Template #3.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Lineage completion cannot falsely prove anti-clone or Dynamic Production Compiler capability.

notes: Fifth Brabus hardening wave. Genome, Template Type System, Constraint Planner and Media Planner/Compiler are PROVEN and lifecycle-closed. This wave creates derived end-to-end production evidence only; it must not mutate compiled Page Schema/package content. Anti-clone and Dynamic Production Compiler remain separate blockers. Template #3 remains forbidden. Canonical full-PR lineage projection reconciled: impacted subsystems are builder-template-system/database-schema/dependency-contract/release-infrastructure/shared-storefront/storefront-ui; SQ-NK-005 and SQ-NK-014 apply; guard digest 1f7fdbbd. New production-lineage.ts is a planned canonical extension under mayEdit until it exists; scaffold and maturity remain mandatory integration edits.
